title: Sekurung village, Lebowakgomo police area (map point estimated): girl, 2, taken from home and killed; woman, 20, arrested, 13 Oct
summary: Police say a two-year-old girl was taken from her home at Sekurung village and fatally stabbed; she also had burn wounds, as the suspect allegedly set fire to the child's home before leaving with her. Police responding t...
story: Police say a two-year-old girl was taken from her home at Sekurung village and fatally stabbed; she also had burn wounds, as the suspect allegedly set fire to the child's home before leaving with her. Police responding to a kidnapping report at about 11:55 on Tuesday 13 October found community members gathered on Sekurung Mountain, where the child's body was found. A 20-year-old woman who was still at the scene was arrested for murder; police also opened a case of malicious damage to property. Afterwards some community members allegedly set the suspect's house alight. The motive is unclear (police, via Review Online and Limpopo Chronicle). No one is named here. Two reports, both resting on police. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: Sekurung could not be placed on a map, so the pin sits on the Lebowakgomo police station, the police area that handled the case. It is not the scene; the village may be up to about 32 km away.

location_note: ESTIMATED MAP POINT. Sekurung village and Sekurung Mountain, in the Lebowakgomo police area (police, via Review Online and Limpopo Chronicle). The village could not be placed on a map: place-name lookups found no Sekurung, and two OpenStreetMap searches returned no data at all, so whether it is mapped is neither confirmed nor ruled out. The pin is on the Lebowakgomo police station (SAPS station point), used only as a reference for the police area that handled the case. It is not the scene or the village. The village may be anywhere in the Lebowakgomo police area, up to about 32 km from the pin. Being near the Mamaolo pin is not a link.
